---
pagetitle: "`r if (nchar(params$committee_name) > 0) params$committee_name else params$committee_code`"
format:
  html:
    echo: false
    message: false
    warning: false
    toc: true
    toc-location: right
    toc-depth: 2
    include-in-header:
      - text: |
          <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css" />

params:
  committee_code: "5185"
  committee_name: ""        # optional display name; auto-populated by render.R
---

```{r}
library(duckdb)
library(DBI)
library(dplyr)
library(dbplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(gt)
library(scales)
library(stringr)
library(here)
library(sf)
library(tigris)
library(jsonlite)
```

```{r}
con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), here("data/campaign_finance/campaign_finance.duckdb"), read_only = TRUE)

comm_meta <- tbl(con, "committees") |>
  filter(committee_code == params$committee_code) |>
  collect()

comm_stats <- tbl(con, "committee_summary") |>
  filter(committee_code == params$committee_code) |>
  collect()

by_year <- tbl(con, "committee_year") |>
  filter(committee_code == params$committee_code) |>
  collect() |>
  mutate(donor_type = str_to_title(donor_type))

by_donor <- tbl(con, "committee_donor") |>
  filter(committee_code == params$committee_code) |>
  collect()

# Loans are dropped before the data reaches OJS rather than filtered in each
# Arquero rollup downstream: every client-side aggregate on this page sums
# contribution_amount, and borrowed money must not land in any of them.
all_contributions <- tbl(con, "contributions") |>
  filter(committee_code == params$committee_code,
         transaction_class != "loan") |>
  select(date, year, donor_display, donor_type, clean_city, norm_state,
         contribution_amount, transaction_class) |>
  arrange(desc(date)) |>
  collect() |>
  mutate(transaction_class = recode(
    transaction_class, contribution = "Cash", in_kind = "In-kind"
  ))

all_expenditures <- tbl(con, "expenditures") |>
  filter(committee_code == params$committee_code) |>
  select(date, year, expenditure_amount, transaction_type,
         recipient_display, city, state) |>
  collect()

dbDisconnect(con)

# Pass data to OJS. Dates formatted as strings; donor_type title-cased for display.
ojs_define(
  by_year_ojs = by_year,
  contributions_ojs = all_contributions |>
    mutate(
      date       = format(date, "%b %d, %Y"),
      donor_type = str_to_title(donor_type)
    ) |>
    rename(city = clean_city, state = norm_state)
)

has_meta          <- nrow(comm_meta) > 0
has_contributions <- nrow(comm_stats) > 0
has_expenditures  <- nrow(all_expenditures) > 0

display_name <- if (nchar(params$committee_name) > 0) {
  params$committee_name
} else if (has_contributions) {
  comm_stats$committee_name[1]
} else if (has_meta) {
  comm_meta$committee_name[1]
} else {
  params$committee_code
}
```

# `r display_name`

```{r}
#| output: asis
# Use comm_stats for enriched metadata (party from API join); comm_meta for county
ci <- if (has_contributions) comm_stats[1, ] else NULL
mi <- if (has_meta) comm_meta[1, ] else NULL

show_field <- function(label, val) {
  if (!is.null(val) && !is.na(val) && nchar(as.character(val)) > 0)
    cat(sprintf("**%s:** %s  \n", label, val))
}

if (!is.null(ci)) {
  show_field("Candidate",    ci$candidate_name)
  show_field("Committee Type", ci$committee_type)
  show_field("Party",        ci$party)
  show_field("Office Sought", ci$office_sought)
  show_field("District",     ci$district)
  show_field("Election Year", ci$election_year)
  show_field("County",       if (!is.null(mi)) mi$county else NA)
} else if (!is.null(mi)) {
  show_field("Committee Type", mi$committee_type)
  show_field("Party",        mi$party)
  show_field("County",       mi$county)
} else {
  cat("\n*Committee not found in the Iowa IECDB registry.*\n")
}
cat(sprintf("**Committee Code:** %s  \n", params$committee_code))
```

## Summary

### Contributions Received

```{r}
if (has_contributions) {
  cs <- comm_stats[1, ]
  summary_df <- data.frame(
    Metric = c(
      "Cash Contributions", "In-Kind Contributions", "Loans Received",
      "Number of Transactions", "Unique Donors",
      "Average Cash Contribution", "Earliest Contribution", "Latest Contribution"
    ),
    Value = c(
      dollar(cs$total_contributions),
      dollar(cs$total_in_kind),
      dollar(cs$total_loans),
      comma(cs$n_transactions),
      comma(cs$n_unique_donors),
      if (is.na(cs$avg_contribution)) "—" else dollar(cs$avg_contribution),
      format(as.Date(cs$first_contribution), "%B %d, %Y"),
      format(as.Date(cs$last_contribution),  "%B %d, %Y")
    )
  )
  gt(summary_df) |>
    cols_label(Metric = "", Value = "") |>
    tab_options(column_labels.hidden = TRUE)
} else {
  cat("No contribution data found for this committee.\n")
}
```

### Donor Type Breakdown

```{r}
if (nrow(by_donor) > 0) {
  grand_total <- sum(by_donor$total_donated, na.rm = TRUE)

  by_type <- by_donor |>
    mutate(donor_type = str_to_title(donor_type)) |>
    group_by(donor_type) |>
    summarize(
      total        = sum(total_donated, na.rm = TRUE),
      transactions = sum(transactions, na.rm = TRUE),
      donors       = n(),
      .groups      = "drop"
    ) |>
    arrange(desc(total)) |>
    mutate(pct = total / grand_total)

  gt(by_type) |>
    cols_label(
      donor_type   = "Donor Type",
      total        = "Total Given",
      pct          = "Share",
      transactions = "Transactions",
      donors       = "Unique Donors"
    ) |>
    fmt_currency(columns = total, currency = "USD") |>
    fmt_percent(columns = pct, decimals = 1) |>
    fmt_integer(columns = c(transactions, donors)) |>
    tab_options(table.font.size = px(12))
} else {
  cat("No contribution data available.\n")
}
```

```{ojs}
// Arquero: use the Observable-native module which exports {aq, op} as named bindings.
// "import * as aq" is NOT valid OJS syntax (namespace imports unsupported).
import { aq, op } from "@uwdata/arquero"
```

```{ojs}
// Leaflet: require() handles CJS modules reliably; default "import L from" is unreliable in OJS.
L = require("leaflet@1.9.4")
```


```{ojs}
// ── Data setup ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
contributions_rows = transpose(contributions_ojs)
by_year_rows       = transpose(by_year_ojs)

contribs_tbl = aq.from(contributions_rows)
by_year_tbl  = aq.from(by_year_rows)
```

```{ojs}
// ── Shared year range filter ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
yearMin = d3.min(contributions_rows, d => d.year)
yearMax = d3.max(contributions_rows, d => d.year)

viewof shared_start = Inputs.range([yearMin, yearMax], {
  label: "From year", step: 1, value: yearMin, format: d3.format("d"), width: 200
})

viewof shared_end = Inputs.range([yearMin, yearMax], {
  label: "To year", step: 1, value: yearMax, format: d3.format("d"), width: 200
})
```

```{ojs}
// ── Shared currency / integer formatters (used across all tabs) ───────────────
fmt_usd = x => x == null ? "" : "$" + x.toLocaleString("en-US", {minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2})
fmt_int = x => x == null ? "" : x.toLocaleString("en-US")
```

## Contributions Over Time

```{ojs}
// Filter by_year (one row per year × donor_type) to the selected range
ot_tbl = by_year_tbl.filter(aq.escape(d => d.year >= shared_start && d.year <= shared_end))

// Roll up to one total per year across all donor types
ot_totals = ot_tbl
  .groupby("year")
  .rollup({total: d => op.sum(d.total)})
  .orderby("year")
  .objects()

Plot.plot({
  title: "Contributions Received by Year",
  x: {tickFormat: "d", label: null},
  y: {tickFormat: "$,", label: "Total Amount", grid: true},

    Plot.barY(ot_totals, {x: "year", y: "total", fill: "#2C5F8A", tip: true}),
    Plot.ruleY([0])
  ],
  width: 640
})
```

## Top Donors

```{ojs}
// Row-level contributions filtered to the selected year range
range_tbl = contribs_tbl.filter(aq.escape(d => d.year >= shared_start && d.year <= shared_end))

// Arquero-based aggregation: group by donor, sum contributions, take top 25
function aggregateDonors(tbl) {
  return tbl
    .groupby("donor_display")
    .rollup({
      total:        d => op.sum(d.contribution_amount),
      transactions: op.count(),
      cities:       op.array_agg('city'),
      states:       op.array_agg('state')
    })
    .derive({
      city:  aq.escape(d => (d.cities || [])[0] || ""),
      state: aq.escape(d => (d.states || [])[0] || "")
    })
    .orderby(aq.desc("total"))
    .slice(0, 25)
    .objects()
}

top_individuals = aggregateDonors(range_tbl.filter(aq.escape(d => d.donor_type === "Individual")))
top_orgs        = aggregateDonors(range_tbl.filter(aq.escape(d => d.donor_type === "Organization" || d.donor_type === "Committee")))
```

## Donor Geography

### Iowa vs. Outside Iowa

```{ojs}
geo_grand_total = range_tbl
  .rollup({t: d => op.sum(d.contribution_amount)})
  .get("t", 0) || 1

ia_vs_outside = range_tbl
  .derive({region: aq.escape(d => d.state === "IA" ? "Iowa" : "Outside Iowa")})
  .groupby("region")
  .rollup({
    total:        d => op.sum(d.contribution_amount),
    transactions: op.count(),
    donors:       op.array_agg('donor_display')
  })
  .derive({donors: aq.escape(d => new Set(d.donors).size)})
  .orderby(aq.desc("total"))
  .objects()
  .map(d => ({...d, pct: d.total / geo_grand_total}))

Inputs.table(ia_vs_outside, {
  columns: ["region", "total", "pct", "transactions", "donors"],
  header:  {region: "", total: "Total Given", pct: "Share", transactions: "Transactions", donors: "Unique Donors"},
  format:  {total: fmt_usd, pct: x => (x * 100).toFixed(1) + "%", transactions: fmt_int, donors: fmt_int}
})
```

### Iowa Deep Dive

```{r}
#| output: false
options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)

city_pts <- NULL

iowa_cities_agg <- by_donor |>
  filter(state == "IA", !is.na(city), nchar(city) > 0) |>
  group_by(city) |>
  summarize(
    total        = sum(total, na.rm = TRUE),
    transactions = sum(transactions, na.rm = TRUE),
    donors       = n(),
    .groups      = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(city_upper = str_to_upper(str_trim(city)))

if (nrow(iowa_cities_agg) > 0) {
  ia_counties <- counties(state = "IA", cb = TRUE, progress_bar = FALSE)
  ia_places   <- places(state = "IA", cb = TRUE, progress_bar = FALSE) |>
    mutate(city_upper = str_to_upper(str_trim(NAME))) |>
    st_centroid()
  city_pts <- ia_places |>
    inner_join(iowa_cities_agg, by = "city_upper")
}

if (!is.null(city_pts) && nrow(city_pts) > 0) {
  city_county_lookup <- city_pts |>
    st_join(ia_counties |> select(county = NAME)) |>
    st_drop_geometry() |>
    select(city = city_upper, county) |>
    distinct()

  tmp_geo <- tempfile(fileext = ".geojson")
  ia_counties |>
    select(county = NAME) |>
    st_transform(4326) |>
    st_write(tmp_geo, quiet = TRUE, delete_dsn = TRUE)

  city_coords_df <- city_pts |>
    st_transform(4326) |>
    mutate(
      lon = st_coordinates(geometry)[, 1],
      lat = st_coordinates(geometry)[, 2]
    ) |>
    st_drop_geometry() |>
    select(city = city_upper, lon, lat)

  ojs_define(
    county_geojson  = fromJSON(tmp_geo, simplifyVector = FALSE),
    city_coords_ojs = city_coords_df,
    city_county_ojs = city_county_lookup
  )
} else {
  ojs_define(
    county_geojson  = list(type = "FeatureCollection", features = list()),
    city_coords_ojs = data.frame(city = character(), lon = numeric(), lat = numeric()),
    city_county_ojs = data.frame(city = character(), county = character())
  )
}
```

```{ojs}
city_coords_rows = transpose(city_coords_ojs)
city_county_rows = transpose(city_county_ojs)

// Static city → county lookup from R spatial join
city_to_county = new Map(city_county_rows.map(d => [d.city, d.county]))

// Arquero: re-aggregate Iowa contributions for the selected year range
iowa_tbl = range_tbl.filter(aq.escape(d => d.state === "IA" && d.city))

iowa_city_totals = iowa_tbl
  .groupby("city")
  .rollup({
    total:        d => op.sum(d.contribution_amount),
    transactions: op.count(),
    donors:       op.array_agg('donor_display')
  })
  .derive({donors: aq.escape(d => new Set(d.donors).size)})
  .orderby(aq.desc("total"))
  .objects()

// Roll city totals up to county level for the choropleth
// city_to_county keys are UPPERCASE (from city_upper in R); iowa_city_totals.city is title-cased
county_totals_map = aq.from(iowa_city_totals)
  .derive({county: aq.escape(d => city_to_county.get(d.city ? d.city.toUpperCase() : null))})
  .filter(aq.escape(d => d.county != null))
  .groupby("county")
  .rollup({total: d => op.sum(d.total)})
  .objects()

// city_coords_rows[].city is UPPERCASE; iowa_city_totals[].city is title-cased
// Use title-cased city name from iowa_city_totals for popup display
city_dot_data = city_coords_rows
  .map(d => {
    const m = iowa_city_totals.find(c => c.city && c.city.toUpperCase() === d.city);
    return m ? {lat: d.lat, lon: d.lon, city: m.city, total: m.total} : null;
  })
  .filter(Boolean)
```

```{ojs}
// Leaflet interactive map — re-renders when county_totals_map or city_dot_data changes
{
  const div = document.createElement("div");
  div.style.cssText = "height: 460px; width: 100%; border-radius: 4px;";
  yield div;

  const map = L.map(div, {scrollWheelZoom: false})
    .fitBounds([[40.3, -96.7], [43.5, -90.1]]);

  L.tileLayer("https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/light_all/{z}/{x}/{y}{r}.png", {
    attribution: "&copy; <a href='https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright'>OpenStreetMap</a> &copy; <a href='https://carto.com/'>CARTO</a>",
    subdomains: "abcd",
    maxZoom: 19
  }).addTo(map);

  // County choropleth — blue gradient scaled to max county total
  const maxCounty = Math.max(...county_totals_map.map(d => d.total), 1);
  const countyColor = t => t == null
    ? "#f0f0f0"
    : d3.interpolateBlues(0.15 + (t / maxCounty) * 0.85);

  L.geoJSON(county_geojson, {
    style: f => {
      const m = county_totals_map.find(d => d.county === f.properties.county);
      return {fillColor: countyColor(m?.total ?? null), weight: 1, color: "white", fillOpacity: 0.75};
    },
    onEachFeature: (f, layer) => {
      const m = county_totals_map.find(d => d.county === f.properties.county);
      layer.bindPopup(`<b>${f.properties.county} County</b><br>${m ? fmt_usd(m.total) : "No data"}`);
    }
  }).addTo(map);

  // City dots — orange circles scaled to donation total
  const maxCity = Math.max(...city_dot_data.map(d => d.total), 1);
  for (const city of city_dot_data) {
    L.circleMarker([city.lat, city.lon], {
      radius:      Math.max(3, Math.sqrt(city.total / maxCity) * 20),
      fillColor:   "#FF8C00",
      color:       "white",
      weight:      1,
      fillOpacity: 0.85
    })
    .bindPopup(`<b>${city.city}</b><br>${fmt_usd(city.total)}`)
    .addTo(map);
  }

  // Fix for Quarto tabset: map initializes while the div is hidden (zero dimensions),
  // so fitBounds() does nothing. ResizeObserver fires when the tab becomes visible.
  // Re-fit to Iowa once on first real resize; subsequent resizes only invalidate size.
  let fittedIowa = false;
  new ResizeObserver(() => {
    map.invalidateSize();
    if (!fittedIowa && div.offsetWidth > 0) {
      map.fitBounds([[40.3, -96.7], [43.5, -90.1]]);
      fittedIowa = true;
    }
  }).observe(div);
}
```
